description: Scored US and global macro briefs from official public data (FRED, BLS, BEA, World Bank): economic regime, inflation, labor market, rates and yield curve, bank credit stress, commodities and supply chain, and an 8-country comparison. Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend versus the horizon, the inputs that drive it, risk flags, confidence and a citation for every input. Includes a CPI inflation calculator. POST /v1/brief with a small JSON body for one scored, cited brief; POST /v1/overview for all of them at once. Results vary as public data updates (5-minute cache). Research signal, not investment advice. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

inputSchema.description: Body for POST /v1/brief (other routes take similar small bodies).

outputSchema.description: {service, vertical, title, status, score (0-100), label, trend, trend_basis, summary, drivers[], risk_flags[], confidence{score,label}, coverage, inputs[], watch[], citations[{url}], method}. Errors return a JSON object with an error field (HTTP 400).

responseSummary.weakest_input: Import prices +6.95% y/y, top of range (scored 0)
